title: HyperFormer generator replaced by Mirror basis
hypothesis: A task×layer×position Mirror basis may replace generic HyperFormer++ generation at lower actual bytes without losing held-out adapter quality.
blocker: HYPERFORMER_MIRROR_CODE_FAMILY_DIAGNOSTIC_2026-10-08 pauses unchanged task×layer×position code-output variants after MA-461 and MA-462 miss frozen gates for the same seen-fidelity/native-control cause. MA-594 does not specify a materially distinct insertion or attribution control.
